propositions: CodeQL workflow was running weekly (23 4 * * 1) as a between-pushes backstop after push-on-main trigger was removed in commit 03ef, leaving newly-introduced SAST findings unscanned for up to 7 days
CodeQL must move to the 6-hourly cadence (35 */6 * * *) that replaced push-on-main, restoring scanning coverage of newly-landed code to 6-hour windows
Four 6-hourly branch-health lanes must use distinct off-the-hour minutes (test.yml :41, optionality.yml :47, verify-identity.yml :53, codeql.yml :35) to avoid GitHub scheduler congestion
CodeQL has no push trigger and cannot join the _SIX_HOURLY tuple (which also drives push-preservation for non-main branches), requiring a separate schedule-only cohort in the test policy
The outdated header comment asserting a 28x cost increase and deliberate weekly cadence must be removed, since navapbc/rebar is public and CodeQL/Actions minutes are free
